title: Concept-Based Interpretability for Toxicity Detection
findings: The concept of 'Religion' showed mixed behavior in the model. While religion-related terms were strong indicators for correctly classifying hate samples, they also led to over-attribution in some non-hate samples, causing misclassifications.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured model attribution to the 'Religion' concept in hate speech classification. Specifically, it used Concept Gradient (CG) scores to quantify whether the model over-attributes toxicity to religion-related terms, leading to misclassifications.
